rules.name: Mission Tactics
rules.description:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

Furor Tactics

If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Malleus Tactics

If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Purgatus Tactics

If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].

DEATHWATCH ALLIES

You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a DEATHWATCH model to be your WARLORD. In addition KILL TEAM units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.

This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

rules.name: Codex Fire-patterns
rules.description: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

enhancements.name: Champion of the First Company
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

enhancements.name: Corporeum Reliquary
enhancements.description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

stratagems.name: Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Merciless Veterans
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

[Lethal Hits].
[Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.name: Gunship Extraction
stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

rules.name: Death Blow
rules.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Instinctive Interception
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
enhancements.description: Death Company model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

stratagems.name: Death Begets Vengeance
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Death Company unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.effect:
That enemy unit is hated until the end of the battle:

While a unit is hated, friendly DEATH COMPANY units’ attacks that target that unit have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.name: No Barrier To Retribution
stratagems.when: Your Movement or your Charge phase, when a friendly Death Company Dreadnought unit is selected to make a normal/advance/charge move.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Mobile.

stratagems.name: Rage-Fuelled Response
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged Death Company unit has shot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

rules.name: Sanguinius' Fury
rules.description:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:

■ At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.

■ The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit.

This means that, regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
